ceo_directive_7_response: Replace unsupported commercial numbers with explicit model

canonical_numbers.source: This artifact is the single source of truth (CEO §8)

value_components.source: Acquisition skips preclinical + IDE cycle (18 months) + regulatory review (6 months)
value_components.assumption: CereVasc has existing eShunt infrastructure to integrate the module
value_components.calculation: 48 months build - 24 months acquire = 24 months saved

value_components.assumption: CereVasc would otherwise build this internally
value_components.calculation: If acquired, CereVasc avoids $13.5M internal development cost

value_components.assumption: Patent grants with claims covering L1-L6; continuation claims filed for design-arounds
value_components.calculation: If 103 resolves as NON_OBVIOUS: HIGH value. If 103 resolves as OBVIOUS: LOW value. Expected value: MEDIUM.

value_components.source: Size-selective membrane is therapeutic-agnostic (albumin, IgG, bevacizumab all retained)
value_components.assumption: Each therapeutic requires its own clinical validation but shares the device platform
value_components.calculation: Platform supports multiple therapeutics → multiple product SKUs from one device

value_components.source: 102 blocks direct endovascular CSF-venous retention; does not block VP shunt (DA3) or alternative mechanisms (DA2, DA6, DA7)
value_components.assumption: Continuation claims filed for DA2 (charge-based), DA4 (pulsed), DA6 (hydrogel), DA7 (affinity)
value_components.calculation: Base claim blocks direct competitors; continuations needed for full territory coverage

value_components.source: Buyer inherits reproducible engineering simulation + fail-safe design + manufacturing spec
value_components.assumption: Engineering package reduces buyer's development risk by ~30%
value_components.calculation: 30% risk reduction × $13.5M build cost = $4.05M risk-adjusted value

core_question: Why would CereVasc pay us instead of building the technology internally?

core_answer.reason_1_time: CereVasc saves 24 months by acquiring vs. building (24 months × ~$0.5M/month burn = $12M time value)
core_answer.reason_2_ip: CereVasc acquires the patent application — blocks competitors from the retention space (if 103 resolves favorably)
core_answer.reason_3_platform: CereVasc gains a therapeutic-retention platform — multiple product SKUs from one device
core_answer.reason_4_risk: CereVasc inherits reproducible engineering + fail-safe + manufacturing — reduces their development risk
core_answer.reason_5_regulatory: CereVasc can leverage existing eShunt PMA (if confirmed) for combination product pathway — faster regulatory
core_answer.net_assessment: If 103 resolves as NON_OBVIOUS and CereVasc PMA is confirmed: acquisition value > $13.5M build cost. If 103 resolves as OBVIOUS: acquisition value < build cost (no IP moat).
core_answer.confidence: MEDIUM — depends on 103 resolution and PMA verification
